# tako's reserved URL surface. Every line is a contract:
# deployed Scheduler jobs, push subscriptions, alert queries and
# user sign-in code are all written against these strings.
prefix	/_tako/
room	/_tako/api/
room	/_tako/z/
Session	/_tako/api/session
SignOut	POST /_tako/api/session/signout
Push	POST /_tako/api/push
Signed	/_tako/api/signed/
Cron	POST /_tako/api/cron/{cron}
SignIn	GET /_tako/signin
